verdict.rationale: Shopify Agentic Commerce's actual product surfaces (UCP CLI, Catalog/Cart/Checkout/Order MCP servers, negotiation logic) are described only as hosted Shopify services with no license or repository link; the only 'public GitHub repository' mentioned is for the industry-wide UCP protocol specification and reference implementations, not Shopify's own product implementation. No evidence shows Shopify's product source is available under an open license.
